hypotheses.rationale: The weekend pattern shows later breakfast (no bowl observed until 11:51 keys at counter suggests out later), later dinner (18:30 vs 18:37 on weekdays), and earlier cleanup (19:15 vs later on weekdays). This supports a work-week routine with different weekend habits.
The weekend pattern could align with a student's schedule, but the structured weekday pattern makes this less likely.
The distinct weekend pattern doesn't align with a retired person who would likely have more consistent daily routines.
